Alright, let's cut the chitchat.
With the golems endangering the town, as the Magistrate, I can't ignore this.

say:10:1013012009:1.text: Protecting Holistone and confronting those golems... Knight Temesia and her squad took part. But the town's defenses are limited...

say:17:1013012016:0.text: Apologies for the intrusion, everyone. We're just following Dura's wishes.
say:17:1013012016:0.source_cn: 那么诸位，打扰了。我们只是在遵行艾雅的意志。

say:20:1013012017:0.text: So, from now on, we're comrades fighting alongside each other.
say:20:1013012017:0.source_cn: 所以，今后我们就是并肩作战的战友了。

say:21:1013012018:0.text: Assisting those in need is an honor for Templar Knights. There's no need for formalities between us!
say:21:1013012018:0.source_cn: 扶危济困是圣堂骑士的荣誉所在，千万不要和我客气！

say:22:1013012019:2.text: ...Ugh, I'm not good at handling these types of people.
say:22:1013012019:2.source_cn: ……完蛋，我最不擅长应付这种一根筋了。
